payload.title: 9. Stage S7: Papyrus 5.130.2 (the 5.130 contract: generated build spec, procedures, agents stack)
payload.description:
Pin checklist (every stage): set the exact version in package.json, infra/package.json, infra/site.json (papyrusVersion) and requirements-publication.txt; run npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts in the root and in infra/; run npm ci && echo {} > amplify_outputs.json && npx papyrus-app sync && npx tsc --noEmit, the Python unit tests with the new papyrus-newsroom, and bin/build_local_site.py; open a pull request into develop; the stage ships in its own release (develop into main, merge commit) that carries nothing else. Read the stage commit list in Papyrus for site.json, papyrus.config.ts or projection.json changes before merging. Releases beyond two a day need Ryan's say-so.
After the deploy, verify (read-only): CI and deploy jobs green; Amplify job SUCCEED; root stack UPDATE_COMPLETE; the stage's index ACTIVE (aws dynamodb describe-table, IndexStatus); sitemap.xml still lists 42 URLs and the five sample pages have the same visible text; /newsroom loads and sign-in works; router and collector logs show no new error. Stop rule: see the epic. Do not start the next stage until all of this holds. Not between 02:50 and 03:50 UTC.
One pull request, released alone. (1) Pins. (2) amplify.yml becomes the generated spec, as Machines on Machines did in its PR 319: npx papyrus-infra print-buildspec --site infra/site.json --app cms-production > amplify.yml (regenerate at every later bump); add a check that amplify.yml equals it (behave feature as Machines on Machines, or a unittest: question 8 on the plan). (3) Procedures: the first line of procedures/ttab_ruling_analysis.tac, ruling_fact_check.tac and ruling_copy_edit.tac becomes '-- papyrus-procedure-kind: <kind>' (distinctive.ttab.ruling-analysis, distinctive.ruling.fact-check, distinctive.ruling.copy-edit) with the existing description comment below; new papyrus-site-procedures.json at the root: version 1 and those three kinds mapped to the three files. (4) infra/site.json tenant settings as decided in task 1 (PAPYRUS_SITE_ID and PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID in cms.environment), reaching the branch through a second app-shell deploy BEFORE this release and only after any adoption. (5) AGENTS.md: bump section says the spec is generated; Where it runs gains the wake queue and agent policy. Index created: LocalizationRequest.listLocalizationRequestsByStateAndRequestedAt (5.115.0). New tables EntityLabel, AnnouncementDecision, Delivery; new agents stack (wake queue papyrus-distinctive-agent-wakes.fifo with dead-letter queue and alarm, schedule group), admin-agent-policy-grant stack. The first build runs papyrus-infra backend-deploy with cost tag waves (several passes; PapyrusCostTagWave must reach complete), then procedures seed-required (registers 15 core procedures and the three site ones), agents apply, agents schedules.
Fallback if CloudFormation refuses the operation for resource count: S7a 5.126.0 then S7b 5.130.2 (both pass the ledger).
Window: finish, with the hold lift (task 15), in one UTC day before 02:58 UTC.
Acceptance:
Scenario: S7 deploys and registers
  Given S6 is verified
  When the 5.130.2 pin pull request is released
  Then the build log shows procedures seed-required, agents apply and agents schedules succeeding, the wake queue and its dead-letter queue exist, and automations list still shows the three Distinctive automations enabled
